newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Swedish Jan unemployment to rise to 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Swedish Jan unemployment to rise to 8.8 pct.

text.p: Open Swedish unemployment is expected to rise to 8.8 percent in January from 8.7 percent in December, a poll of 18 analysts showed on Friday.
Forecasts ranged from 8.0 to 9.3 percent with the median at 8.9 percent. In January 1996 the jobless rate was 8.1 percent.
For calendar 1997 analysts on average expect the unemployment rate to fall to 7.5 from 8.1 percent in 1996 with the median at 7.6 percent. Forecasts range from 7.0 percent to 7.9 percent.

Sources participating in the poll were Aragon, Carnegie, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, HSBC Midland, J P Morgan, Lehman Brothers, Merrill Lynch, Nomura, Nordbanken, PaineWebber, S-E-Banken, Sparbanken, Union Bank of Switzerland, Unibank Markets.
Sources which gave only monthly figures were Aragon, Carnegie, Consensus, HSBC Midland, J P Morgan, Lehman Brothers, Nomura, PaineWebber.
Statistics Sweden is due to publish the figure on February 7 at 1200 GMT.
